segment.basis: Exact device/header timestamps from audit samples #01 and #04; relative to the first depth frame.

sampling.target_definition: start_ns + k * 200000000, integer k >= 0, target <= end_ns
sampling.selection: Nearest actual RGB timestamp within the inclusive source interval, earlier frame wins a tie; use each source RGB at most once.
sampling.depth_association: Use audited device/header nearest-depth association, enforce injective use of actual depth frames and an absolute offset <= 10 ms.
sampling.quality_screening: Inspect actual selected frames for decode failures, severe blur, occlusion/dynamic foreground and overlap. Record measured distributions, rejection reasons and retained count; no universal blur threshold is prefilled.
